name: keystone
notes: Keystone 0.9.2 (tag commit dc7932ef2b2c4a793836caec6ecab485005139d6). Installed as the keystone-engine PyPI sdist in .venv/ (sha256 is of the sdist, re-downloaded from files.pythonhosted.org and matched to the PyPI digest). bin/kstool and lib/libkeystone.0.dylib are the CLI and library for macOS arm64. test.sh passes: MIPS big-endian, Thumb, ARM and PPC bytes checked through kstool, plus the Python binding.
